situation.en: You're spending a semester in Boston. Your classmate Chris calls to invite you to the movies with some friends on Friday night, but you already have plans that evening.
situation.he: אתם בסמסטר לימודים בבוסטון. חבר לכיתה, כריס, מתקשר להזמין אתכם לסרט עם כמה חברים ביום שישי בערב, אבל באותו ערב כבר יש לכם תוכניות.

goal.en: Decline politely with a reason, suggest another day, agree on the details, and reschedule smoothly if plans change.
goal.he: לסרב בנימוס עם סיבה, להציע יום אחר, לסגור את הפרטים, ולדחות בצורה נעימה אם התוכניות משתנות.

phrases.en: Would you like to come to the movies with us?
Do you fancy coming to the cinema with us?
I'd love to, but I can't make it on Friday.
phrases.he: הייתי שמח/ה, אבל ביום שישי אני לא יכול/ה.

phrases.en: Sounds good! What time works for you?
phrases.he: נשמע טוב! איזו שעה מתאימה לך?

phrases.en: Something's come up. Could we do another day?
phrases.he: צץ לי משהו. אפשר לעשות את זה ביום אחר?
phrases.note: 'Something's come up' = something unexpected has happened. You don't have to explain more.

phrases.en: Can I take a rain check?
phrases.note: = Not this time, but I'd like to another time. Mainly American, but widely understood.

phrases.en: Thanks so much for the invite!
phrases.note: 'Invite' as a noun is informal; write 'invitation' in formal messages.

model_dialogue.speaker: partner
model_dialogue.text: Hey! What are you up to on Friday night?

model_dialogue.speaker: partner
model_dialogue.text: A few of us are going to the movies, and then getting pizza. Want to come?

model_dialogue.speaker: you
model_dialogue.text: Oh, I'd love to, but I can't make it on Friday. I've already got plans with my roommates.

model_dialogue.speaker: partner
model_dialogue.text: Aw, that's too bad. What about Saturday? We could do the movie then.

model_dialogue.speaker: you
model_dialogue.text: Saturday works! What time were you thinking?

model_dialogue.speaker: partner
model_dialogue.text: Maybe the seven o'clock show, then pizza after?

model_dialogue.speaker: you
model_dialogue.text: Sounds perfect, count me in. Where should we meet?

model_dialogue.speaker: partner
model_dialogue.text: Let's meet outside the theater at a quarter to seven.

model_dialogue.speaker: you
model_dialogue.text: Great. Thanks so much for the invite!

model_dialogue.speaker: partner
model_dialogue.text: Of course! Oh, and Maya might come too.

practice.partner: Hey! A few of us are going to the movies on Friday night. Want to come?

feedback.en: Honest, but it sounds cold, as if you're not interested. Start with 'I'd love to, but…'
feedback.he: כנה, אבל נשמע קר, כאילו זה לא מעניין אתכם. כדאי להתחיל ב-I'd love to, but...

options.text: Oh, I'd love to, but I can't make it on Friday. I've already got plans.

feedback.en: Warm first ('I'd love to'), then a soft no with a short reason. Very natural.
feedback.he: קודם חום (I'd love to), ואחר כך סירוב רך עם סיבה קצרה. טבעי מאוד.

options.text: No, I don't want to go with you.

feedback.en: Very hurtful, even if you're just busy. If you're not interested, use a soft line: 'Thanks, but I'll pass this time.'
feedback.he: פוגע מאוד, גם אם אתם פשוט עסוקים. אם זה לא מעניין אתכם, אפשר לסרב ברכות: Thanks, but I'll pass this time.

model_replies: Oh, I'd love to, but I can't make it on Friday. I've already got plans.
Thanks for asking! Friday's tricky for me, though. Could we do another day?

practice.partner: Aw, that's too bad. What about Saturday instead?

options.text: Saturday I can. When it starts?

feedback.en: Word order: 'I can do Saturday', and the question needs 'does': 'When does it start?'
feedback.he: סדר מילים: I can do Saturday, ובשאלה צריך does: When does it start?

options.text: Saturday works! What time were you thinking?

feedback.en: Enthusiastic and moves the plan forward. 'What time were you thinking?' is a soft way to ask.
feedback.he: נלהב ומקדם את התוכנית. What time were you thinking? היא דרך רכה לשאול.

options.text: Yes, Saturday is possible for me. At what time would you like to meet?

feedback.en: Correct, but formal and a bit flat. 'Saturday works!' sounds keener, and 'What time?' is enough.
feedback.he: נכון, אבל רשמי וקצת יבש. Saturday works! נשמע נלהב יותר, ו-What time? מספיק.

model_replies: Saturday works! What time were you thinking?

practice.partner: Maybe the seven o'clock show, then pizza after?

options.text: Sounds perfect, count me in! Where should we meet?

feedback.en: Clear yes, some enthusiasm, and a practical next step.
feedback.he: 'כן' ברור, קצת התלהבות וצעד מעשי להמשך.

options.text: Hmm, maybe. I will think and I will tell you tomorrow, after I check my plans.

feedback.en: Sounds unsure after you've just said Saturday works, and 'I will think and I will tell you' is translated word for word from Hebrew. The natural phrase is 'Let me think about it and get back to you', but here it's better to just say yes.
feedback.he: נשמע מהסס אחרי שרק עכשיו אמרתם ששבת מתאימה, ו-I will think and I will tell you הוא תרגום מילולי של 'אחשוב ואגיד לך'. הניסוח הטבעי הוא Let me think about it and get back to you, אבל כאן עדיף פשוט להסכים.

feedback.en: Fine, but very minimal for an invitation. Show some enthusiasm.
feedback.he: בסדר, אבל מינימלי מדי כתגובה להזמנה. כדאי להראות קצת התלהבות.

model_replies: Sounds perfect, count me in! Where should we meet?
Great, see you there. Should we meet outside?

practice.partner: Hey, are we still on for tonight?

options.text: Oh, I forgot to tell you, I'm not coming. My cousin's in town, so I'm going out with her tonight instead.

feedback.en: Cancelling at the last minute with no apology sounds careless, even with a reason. Say sorry and suggest another time.
feedback.he: ביטול ברגע האחרון בלי התנצלות נשמע לא אכפתי, גם כשיש סיבה. כדאי להתנצל ולהציע מועד אחר.

options.text: I'm so sorry, something's come up and I can't make it tonight. Could we do next weekend instead?

feedback.en: Apologise, give a short reason and suggest a new time right away. It shows you still want to meet.
feedback.he: מתנצלים, נותנים סיבה קצרה ומציעים מיד מועד חדש. זה מראה שאתם עדיין רוצים להיפגש.

feedback.en: Polite enough, but without a new suggestion it can sound like you don't want to meet. Offer another day.
feedback.he: מנומס מספיק, אבל בלי הצעה חדשה זה עלול להישמע כאילו אתם לא רוצים להיפגש. כדאי להציע יום אחר.

model_replies: I'm so sorry, something's come up and I can't make it tonight. Could we do next weekend instead?
Really sorry, I have to cancel tonight. Can I take a rain check? How about next Saturday?

practice.partner: No worries! Next weekend works for me. I'll let the others know.

feedback.en: Fine, but after cancelling, a bit more warmth helps: 'Thanks for understanding.'
feedback.he: בסדר, אבל אחרי ביטול כדאי קצת יותר חום: Thanks for understanding.

feedback.en: Sounds uncommitted right after you cancelled. Confirm the new plan clearly.
feedback.he: נשמע לא מחויב, ודווקא אחרי שביטלתם. כדאי לאשר את התוכנית החדשה בבירור.

options.text: Thanks for understanding. I'll text you during the week to set a time.

feedback.en: Grateful and committed: you take responsibility for the next step.
feedback.he: מכירים תודה ומראים מחויבות: לוקחים אחריות על הצעד הבא.

model_replies: Thanks for understanding. I'll text you during the week to set a time.
Thanks, Chris. Next weekend it is!

roleplay.persona: Chris, a classmate on the learner's semester in Boston. Easygoing and sociable, always organising group plans, but a bit vague about details.
roleplay.complication: Chris invites the learner for a night they can't make. After they agree on another day, Chris changes the time because of another friend, so the learner has to check whether it works, maybe suggest a different time, and confirm the final plan: day, time and place.
roleplay.opening_line: Hey! What are you up to on Friday night?

culture.en: In English, a direct 'No' to an invitation can sound unfriendly. People soften it ('I'd love to, but…') and suggest another time if they mean it.
culture.he: באנגלית 'לא' ישיר להזמנה עלול להישמע לא ידידותי. נוהגים לרכך (I'd love to, but...) ולהציע מועד אחר אם באמת רוצים.

culture.en: 'What are you up to on Friday?' often comes before an invitation. If you don't know the plan yet, answer 'Nothing much, why?' or 'Why, what's up?'
culture.he: השאלה What are you up to on Friday? באה הרבה פעמים לפני הזמנה. אם עוד לא יודעים מה התוכנית, עונים Nothing much, why? או Why, what's up?

culture.en: If you need to cancel, tell people as early as possible and apologise. Not turning up without a message is considered very rude.
culture.he: אם צריך לבטל, מודיעים כמה שיותר מוקדם ומתנצלים. לא להגיע בלי להודיע נחשב לחוסר נימוס חמור.

variants.us: go to the movies / movie theater
variants.note: 'Movie' is understood everywhere; 'film' is more British.
'Do you want to…?' is used everywhere.
